moments.title: How COVID Sparked a Food Rescue Movement
moments.insight: College students started FarmLink during COVID by renting U-Hauls to connect surplus farm food with struggling food banks.

moments.title: 150 Million Pounds of Food, 100 Trucks a Week
moments.insight: FarmLink scaled from 40 million pounds of rescued food in its first year to 150 million pounds annually today.

moments.title: From Houseplants to Farm Fields
moments.insight: Eliza describes founding The Sill in 2012 and how that entrepreneurial journey eventually led her to FarmLink.

moments.title: The Triple Win: Food, Farmers, and the Planet
moments.insight: Rescuing surplus food fights hunger, supports farmers, and cuts methane emissions from rotting landfill waste.

moments.title: Why Peach Trees Are Being Bulldozed
moments.insight: Eliza reveals California is paying farmers to destroy peach orchards after Del Monte's bankruptcy killed demand for canned fruit.
